stage1.impression: A tight macro of a woofer seen through blue acrylic. The cone and dust cap are flat, featureless grey with no highlight, the blue ring is an evenly painted, untextured band, and a saturated navy edge strip plus a grey denoised slab at the right pull the eye off the driver. It reads as clean CG product visualization, not a macro photograph.

blocking_9: The cone and dust cap must carry a soft graduated specular highlight and a raking light that shows the paper or poly texture and the edge of the dust cap (dust-cap edge step >= 15, cone lum_range >= 25)
The coloured ring must show a light gradient across its face, not a uniform fill (lum_range >= 20 across the left band)
The tinted acrylic must visibly glow with light passing through it, rather than reading as dark blue-black interior shadows
The frame must centre the driver with clear margin, and the navy edge and grey slab at the right must be removed or reduced to a thin accent
There must be no denoiser blotching on the flat acrylic surfaces and no dark speck on the dust cap

defects.what: Dust cap has almost no form: the edge step is only 4.6 levels over 29 px, and there is no highlight (p95 58)
Single dark pixel speck at the dust cap centre (a modelling pole or a firefly in reverse)
The cone reads as untextured CG plastic: median 35 at the top and 58 at the bottom, with no micro-detail
The blue ring is a flat fill: lum_range 2.9 over a 400 px band, so it reads as painted CG
A saturated navy acrylic edge (RGB 7/23/91) forms a hard vertical bar that competes with the driver
A grey side panel fills 13% of the frame, with mottled denoiser blotches visible at 2x
Busy stacked acrylic edges and reflections across the top add clutter
The ring is cropped tight at the left edge, which puts the composition off balance
The interior behind the acrylic is crushed to blue-black (median 28) where the brief wants glowing tinted acrylic

changes.problem: The cone, dust cap and ring carry no specular gradient, so they read as matte CG.

evidence.measured: ring lum_range 2.9; dust cap [600,680,800,900] p95 58; profile across the cap 41-54

changes.expected: A soft graduated streak runs across the upper-left of the ring and a highlight sits on the dust cap's upper-left shoulder, so both read as curved surfaces with a finish.

changes.problem: The key falls too steeply and evenly to rake the cone, so no texture or dust-cap edge appears.

evidence.measured: dust cap edge largest step 4.6, width 29 px; cone top median 34.5

changes.expected: Grazing light from the left lifts the upper-left cone, puts a terminator on the dust cap and brings out the cone's surface grain.

changes.problem: The driver sits left of centre and is cropped at the left edge, and the navy edge and grey slab take the right 16% of the frame.

evidence.measured: navy strip RGB 7/23/91, lum 25; grey slab median 164

changes.expected: The ring is centred with about 6% margin on every side, and at most a thin sliver of the acrylic edge stays at the right as an accent.

changes.problem: The tinted acrylic around the driver reads as dark blue-black voids rather than glowing coloured glass.
changes.expected: Light passes through the side walls and the cabinet interior glows a mid blue around the ring.

changes.problem: The lower surround rolls into darkness, so the driver has no lower rim to lift it off the ring.
changes.expected: A soft white rim highlight sits on the lower roll of the surround.

changes.problem: Denoiser blotching on the flat acrylic panel and a dark speck on the dust cap give the frame away as a render.

evidence.measured: mottled blotches visible in a 2x crop; lum_range 32 on a nominally flat panel

changes.expected: The flat acrylic is clean and smooth, and the centre speck goes (retouch it if it is geometry).

changes.problem: Midtones are compressed and the cone reads as a single grey.
changes.expected: More local contrast on the cone and the ring edges without clipping.

out_of_scope.request: Give the cone and dust cap a real material (a fibre or paper texture, a fine weave, a slight sheen) instead of a smooth uniform grey shader
out_of_scope.why: This changes the speaker's parts and materials. Light can reveal texture only if the model carries it.

out_of_scope.request: Give the coloured ring a surface finish with micro-texture (cast-acrylic gloss or bead-blast) rather than a uniform matte fill
out_of_scope.why: This changes the speaker's colour or finish, which is fixed.

out_of_scope.request: Remove the modelled pole or speck at the dust cap centre
out_of_scope.why: If it is geometry, it is a model fix rather than a set fix.
